title: Main bootstrap for canonical Hostinger Tenant Canary evidence

phases.objective: Register the read-only Tenant Canary pull-request workflow on main and prove its exact-head producer-to-generic-publisher handshake without promoting Spec 014 runtime or migrations.

e2e_journeys.actor: repository reviewer and trusted CI evidence publisher
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The main-registered Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard and bootstrap contract
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A qualifying pull request is verified at its exact head, produces one run-bound secret-free artifact, and hands that evidence to the trusted generic CI Evidence PR Publisher.
steps: Validate the permanent pull-request workflow, narrow paths, permissions, and exact-head checkout.
Validate canonical artifact identity, routing, report integrity, and generic publisher binding.
assertions: The PR-head workflow has contents:read only and persisted credentials disabled.
The generic publisher checks out trusted main and holds the bounded comment-write authority.
No Hostinger provider call, credential access, migration apply, deployment, or Production mutation occurs.

phases.objective: Observe the first qualifying exact-head Tenant Canary run and trusted publication through the canonical generic publisher.
Reject stale heads, unavailable contexts, missing artifacts, malformed reports, and publisher-route drift while remaining fail closed.
Record exact-head canonical Tenant Canary evidence through the trusted publisher.
This repository governance contract grants no provider, deployment, migration, SQL, or Production mutation authority.
